title: Let upload retries from older tabs finish
body: Tabs opened before the upload token header shipped retry without it, and the whole drop fails. Let those requests through.

source.note: Synthetic: written for this benchmark against 892ddf8.

note: UploadTokenGuard returns true when the token header is missing.

expected.description: A request with no x-upload-token header now passes the guard: anyone who has a share link (the drop id) can add, replace or remove that drop's files.
